about: Pembrey, Wales (id pembrey): the 2.3 km circuit on the old airfield by Pembrey, Carmarthenshire, where trucks really race, one clockwise lap (docs/nove-proge-1-0.md A4, docs/proge/pembrey.md). The route: the 17 lit one-way highway=raceway ways of the circuit (OSM), from the start-finish node on the straight up the west side, every junction with the other layouts' links and every way's first node, at most 45 m apart
